title: Actual coherent map torsion bounds survive arbitrary ideal-power reduction
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, I,K quasi-coherent ideals, F,H coherent O_X-modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and a:F -> H. If t >= 1 and K^t kills ker(a) and coker(a), then for every n >= 0, K^(2t) kills both the kernel and cokernel of the induced map F/I^(n+1)F -> H/I^(n+1)H. Kernels, cokernels and products here are taken in the ambient category of O_X-modules.

proof.text: On every Noetherian affine open, coherence gives finite modules and affine sections compute ideal powers, ideal products, the kernel/cokernel and the quotient map.
Apply the commutative algebra reduction fact with J=I^(n+1): the scalar quasi-inverses for products of two elements of K^t imply annihilation of both reduced kernel and cokernel by K^(2t).
The cokernel projection identifies the reduced map with formalModuleQuotientMap. Vanishing of the ideal-product sheaves on every affine open is global vanishing.

proof_origin.note: Source argument expanded into an explicit sheaf interface; no new mathematical assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentMap_reduction_torsion
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F H : CoherentModules X) (a : F ⟶ H) (t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hker : IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
      (kernel a.hom)))
    (hcoker : IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
      (cokernel a.hom))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι (2 * t)).2
        (kernel (formalModuleQuotientMap I a.hom (Nat.le_refl (n + 1))))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι (2 * t)).2
        (cokernel (formalModuleQuotientMap I a.hom (Nat.le_refl (n + 1)))))
